rows.what: qip_kernel::mismatch routes each fused mismatch to one paper-only record. Investigations and challenges are research-loop acquisition candidates charged to the acquisition budget by launch_ranked (ResearchLoop::admit_mismatch_candidates). Relative-value proposals go to falsification::Book::propose, charged to one family's trial budget (TrialLedger::charge_proposal), journaled on every admission, eviction and budget refusal (MismatchProposalJournal, Topic::HypothesisCreated), rebuilt by mismatch::replay; PROPOSED_CAPACITY=32 is provisional and its evictions and refusals are counted. ADR 0609 rewritten to match.
